semantic_findings: ImageKernel is a genuine equality of image/intersection/kernel submodules of actual operators. The correction theorem constructs x-v(b) from an actual preimage and proves actual cohomology-class preservation and both closure equations. No conclusion is supplied as a hypothesis or record field.

The actual column filtration is generated by genuine signed-total summand inclusions. Zr retains D(x) in F(p+r); Br retains filtered primitives; the denominator has the standard r-1 and p+1 shifts and is proved contained in Zr. Differential descent is defined before the image/kernel assumption.

The first quotient page identifies with actual vertical HomologicalComplex.homology without image/kernel assumptions. All higher actual descended differentials vanish for every integer r>=1 under the componentwise identities; the result is stronger than d1=0.

The mathlib CohomologicalSpectralSequence starts at 1 and uses actual filtered quotient objects and actual descended D in bidegree (r,1-r). Its recurrence is tied to the canonical homology projection by zeroPageHomologyIso_π; next-page cycle inclusion and quotient surjectivity make the common-representative rule cover every next-page class. This is not unsupported constant-page packaging.

The infinity quotient uses actual total cocycles modulo higher filtered cocycles and actual total boundaries. Its canonical comparison targets the associated graded of the range filtration of actual total cohomology classes.

Finite horizontal support makes the actual total filtration finite, and the induced actual cohomology filtration is explicitly finite, exhaustive and separated. For U<p+r and p-r+1<=L, actual page numerators/denominators equal the stable submodules. The canonical stabilized representative theorem sends a total cocycle to its actual graded cohomology class; the modular release-fidelity theorem also equates bounded stabilization and degeneration comparison morphisms.
No analytic compact-Kahler theorem, opposite-filtration/converse equivalence, arbitrary external anticommuting reconstruction or abstract mapping-cone spectral-object comparison is asserted.
